The jetson-orin-nano-8gb-jp62 row is spec_authored and claims r36.4.x, so the device that is supposed to validate that row currently matches no committed row. The nvidia-jetpack package version was never recorded for this device, so this fixture does not claim one; the JetPack version is derived from the L4T line, and r36.5 maps to no known JetPack release.
